results.title: Corporate Treasury, UI Engineering (React), Vice President, NY
results.description:
**Role Overview**

Goldman Sachs is seeking a visionary **Vice President of UI Engineering** to lead the development of next\-generation, mission\-critical React applications. As a VP, you will sit at the intersection of finance and cutting\-edge technology, responsible for architecting scalable front\-end systems that power our payments platform systems. You will lead high\-performing engineering teams, drive technical strategy, and ensure the delivery of high\-performance, accessible, and secure user interfaces.

**Key Responsibilities**
* **Technical Leadership:** Define the architectural roadmap for React\-based micro\-frontends, ensuring modularity, reusability, and performance across the enterprise.
* **Team Management:** Mentor and manage a team of senior UI developers, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, continuous integration, and rapid deployment.
* **Strategic Execution:** Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Backend Engineers to translate complex financial workflows into intuitive digital experiences.
* **Standards \& Governance:** Establish and enforce best practices for state management (e.g., Redux, Recoil), testing (Jest, Cypress), and UI consistency via GS Design Systems.
* **Performance Optimization:** Drive initiatives to optimize application load times and rendering performance for data\-heavy, real\-time financial dashboards.

**Required Qualifications**
* **Experience:** 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 2 years in architectural capacity.
* **Core Tech Stack:** Expert\-level proficiency in **React.js**, TypeScript, and modern CSS (CSS\-in\-JS, Tailwind, or Sass).
* **State \& Data:** Deep understanding of asynchronous data handling, WebSockets for real\-time updates, and complex state management patterns.
* **Architecture:** Proven experience with Micro\-frontend architecture and Module Federation.
* **Testing:** Strong commitment to test\-driven development (TDD) and automated UI testing frameworks.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in FinTech or high\-frequency trading environments.
* Knowledge of cloud\-native deployment (AWS/Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contributions to open\-source projects or active participation in the React community.
**We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits**
Healthcare \& Medical Insurance
We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.


Holiday \& Vacation Policies
We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.


Financial Wellness \& Retirement
We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.


Health Services
We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices.


Fitness
To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on\-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre\-approved amount).


Child Care \& Family Care
We offer on\-site child care centers that provide full\-time and emergency back\-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available.

Read more about the full suite of class\-leading benefits our firm has to offer.

results.title: Senior UX Designer
results.description:
Curinos empowers financial institutions to put customers at the center of every decision. Our AI\-first platform transforms proprietary data, advanced analytics and deep financial services expertise into timely recommendations \- delivered right where teams work. The result: confident decisions, stronger customer relationships, and lasting, profitable growth.


Curinos operates under a hybrid modality and has office locations in New York, Chicago, Boston, Toronto, and London. This role is open to remote candidates based in the United States and able to travel as needed.

**Job Description**


Curinos is seeking a Senior Designer (UX) to join our growing UX chapter within the Product \& Technology organization. This individual will play a critical role in shaping user experiences across our product portfolio by leading design eDorts within cross\-functional product teams. Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, this designer will bring a strong user\-centered mindset to complex, data\-driven products \- balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution. Reporting to the Director of User Experience, this role emphasizes deep craft, collaboration, and influence, helping ensure that UX is a core driver of product quality and business impact.

**Responsibilities**


Champion user\-centered design

* Advocate for user needs by leveraging research, data, and feedback
* Plan and conduct user research and usability testing (in partnership with stakeholders where applicable)
* Iterate on designs based on insights, product analytics, and experimentation


Own and deliver high\-quality product design

* Lead end\-to\-end UX design for key product areas \- from discovery through delivery and iteration
* Translate complex data and workflows into intuitive, eDective user experiences
* Produce high\-quality deliverables including flows, wireframes, prototypes, and final UI design


Collaborate within empowered product teams

* Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to shape product direction and priorities
* Contribute to product discovery, helping define problems and validate solutions early
* Ensure design feasibility and support high\-quality implementation


Influence product strategy

* Bring strong UX perspective into roadmap discussions and product decisions
* Identify opportunities to improve usability, eDiciency, and overall experience quality
* Balance user needs with business goals and technical constraints


Contribute to design systems and standards

* Apply and evolve design systems, patterns, and UX best practices
* Promote consistency, accessibility, and scalability across products
* Help define and improve design workflows and team practices


Mentor and elevate design craft

* Provide guidance and feedback to other designers
* Share knowledge, best practices, and design thinking approaches
* Contribute to a strong, collaborative UX culture


Drive continuous improvement and innovation

* Stay current with UX trends, tools, and emerging technologies
* Bring new ideas and approaches to improve products and processes
* Advocate for quality, simplicity, and meaningful design

 **Salary Range:**$120,000\-$140,000 (plus Bonus)

**Desired Skills \& Expertise**

* 6\+ years of UX design experience
* Strong portfolio demonstrating end\-to\-end product design
* Experience working in cross\-functional product teams
* Experience with complex, data\-heavy or B2B/SaaS products preferred
* Strong systems thinking and interaction design skills

 **Why work at Curinos?**

* Competitive benefits, including a range of Financial, Health and Lifestyle benefits to choose from
* Flexible working options, including home working, flexible hours and part time options, depending on the role requirements – please ask!
* Unlimited PTO policy, floating holidays, volunteering days and a day off for your birthday
* Learning and development tools to assist with your career development
* Work with industry leading Subject Matter Experts and specialist products
* Regular social events and networking opportunities
* Collaborative, supportive culture, including an active DE\&I program
* Employee Assistance Program which provides expert third\-party advice on wellbeing, relationships, legal and financial matters, as well as access to counselling services

 **Applying**


We know that sometimes the 'perfect candidate' doesn't exist, and that people can be put off applying for a job if they don't meet all the requirements. If you're excited about working for us and have relevant skills or experience, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need!


If you need any adjustments to support your application, such as information in alternative formats, special requirements to access our buildings or adjusted interview formats please contact us at careers@curinos.com and we’ll do everything we can to help.

We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, Curinos is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics.

results.title: UX Manager – Amazon Ads on Devices, Amazon Ads
results.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Ads is looking for an experienced UX Manager to lead a team of UX Designers responsible for end\-to\-end advertising experiences across Amazon Devices \- including Fire TV, Fire Tablet, Alexa, and Echo. This leader will own the design strategy for ad experiences that feel native to each device surface, respect the end\-customer experience, deliver measurable results for advertisers, and push the boundaries of what advertising can be on ambient, voice\-first, and living\-room screens.  

  

This role sits at the intersection of multiple device publishers \- each with their own product vision, roadmap, and customer experience bar. You will build deep, trusted relationships with publisher teams across the Devices organization, drive cross\-publisher alignment on shared design standards and ad experience principles, and ensure a cohesive advertising experience for customers regardless of which device surface they encounter. Your ability to navigate competing priorities, find common ground, and champion a unified UX vision across publishers will be critical to success.  

  

You are a builder who ships. You bring urgency and a bias for action to everything you do \- moving ideas from concept to launched experience at a pace that matches the speed of our business. You will integrate AI into the design process to accelerate delivery, unlock creative possibilities, and raise the quality bar. You thrive in ambiguity, bring clarity to complex problems, and have a track record of influencing cross\-functional partners to align on a shared vision and ship together.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the design delivery pipeline from concept through launch \- ensuring the team ships high\-quality advertising experiences across Amazon Devices
* Establish a culture of urgency and accountability; remove blockers, streamline decision\-making, and drive rapid iteration cycles to get experiences into market fast
* Partner with Engineering and Product to compress timelines, identify MVP scopes, and make smart trade\-offs that balance speed with craft
* Measure and communicate the impact of shipped experiences \- engagement rates, ad interaction metrics, advertiser adoption, and customer sentiment \- and use those signals to inform what to build next
* Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships with publisher teams across Amazon Devices — Fire TV, Fire Tablet, Alexa, Echo Show, and emerging device surfaces
* Serve as the primary UX point of contact for device publishers on advertising experience strategy; understand each publisher's product vision, customer experience bar, and technical constraints
* Drive cross\-publisher alignment on shared design standards, ad format specifications, interaction patterns, and quality guardrails \- ensuring a cohesive and consistent advertising experience across the device ecosystem
* Facilitate regular cross\-publisher design reviews, alignment forums, and roadmap syncs to proactively identify conflicts, surface shared opportunities, and build consensus on priorities
* Navigate competing publisher priorities with diplomacy and data; advocate for the customer experience while balancing advertiser needs and publisher goals
* Develop and socialize a unified advertising design language across device surfaces that respects each publisher's unique context while maintaining ecosystem coherence
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of UX Designers, fostering a culture of craft excellence, experimentation, and customer obsession
* Design ad experiences that feel native, contextual, and additive to the device experience \- not interruptive; champion a customer\-first approach to advertising on personal and shared devices
* Champion AI\-powered design workflows \- integrating generative AI, automation, and intelligent tooling into the team's creative process to increase efficiency, speed\-to\-market, and scalability
* Explore emerging interaction paradigms \- voice, gesture, ambient UI, multimodal \- and translate them into innovative, shippable ad formats
* Translate business goals and technical constraints (device performance, screen fidelity, input modality) into compelling, customer\-centric design solutions that can be shipped incrementally
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Science, and Business stakeholders across devices publishers to shape the advertising roadmap and ensure UX is a strategic driver of outcomes
* Influence across organizational boundaries \- building consensus, driving alignment, and resolving ambiguity on complex, cross\-team initiatives where speed and clarity are critical
* Establish strong relationships with partner UX teams across Devices and Ads to ensure consistency and coherence across the broader customer experience
* Drive efficient, predictable delivery of design work; build repeatable processes that enable the team to ship fast without sacrificing quality
* Balance long\-term strategic bets (next\-generation device ad formats) with near\-term delivery commitments; manage the team's portfolio of work across multiple device surfaces with a bias toward action
* Use data, research insights, and customer feedback to inform design decisions and measure the real\-world impact of shipped experiences

  

About the team  

Amazon Ads helps brands design ad experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With billions of first\-party signals and a suite of innovative ad products spanning display, video, audio, and custom formats, we are uniquely positioned to help advertisers reach the right audiences across Amazon's ecosystem and beyond. Our team is passionate about inventing on behalf of customers and pushing the boundaries of what advertising can be.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of design experience
* 3\+ years of leading design teams experience
* Experience leading design teams in problem definition, artifact rendering, cross\-functional collaboration and delivery, and user validation and measurement
* Experience in delivering design solutions for projects of large scope and complexity
* Experience building and growing relationships with internal and external partners
* Experience driving direction and alignment with cross\-functional teams
* Experience designing for device\-based, living\-room, or embedded platforms (smart TVs, tablets, voice assistants, IoT, or similar)
* Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar
* Bachelor's degree or above in design, human\-computer interaction (HCI), or Associate's degree or above

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working cross\-team and synthesize feedback and input from product management, engineering, testing, and marketing
* Experience with agile/scrum
* Experience with voice interface, natural language or multimodal design
* Hands\-on experience with generative AI tools applied to production design processes

results.title: Principal UX Designer, AWS Security, Search, Observability & Governance
results.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We are looking for a Principal UX Designer to define and own the end\-to\-end design strategy for AWS's security, observability, and agentic AI product portfolio. This is a high\-impact IC role with significant organizational influence. You will partner directly with VP\-level Product and Engineering leaders to shape products used by millions of security practitioners worldwide. The ideal candidate combines elite visual craft with deep technical fluency, operates as an "architect of systemic solutions" rather than a feature designer, and has a track record of shipping design systems that scale across complex B2B enterprise environments.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Define the long\-term UX vision and roadmap for AWS Security products (GuardDuty, Security Hub, Detective, Inspector, IAM) in partnership with senior product and engineering leadership  

2\. Architect and govern a unified design system across the security portfolio, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and scalability for high\-density data interfaces  

3\. Lead the design of agentic AI interfaces — including intent\-driven system actions, guided investigations, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows for automated security operations  

4\. Drive "design\-as\-code" practices: build production\-quality prototypes using modern stacks (React, TypeScript) to collapse design\-engineering feedback loops  

5\. Establish UX quality benchmarks and lead critique sessions across the organization, elevating design maturity and craft standards globally  

6\. Mentor and develop a team of senior designers, providing technical guidance and career development  

7\. Represent Design in executive reviews (VP, SVP) with data\-driven recommendations and clear strategic narratives  

8\. Navigate complex stakeholder matrices to build consensus across multiple product teams operating under a shared UX umbrella  

  

A day in the life  

Your morning might start with a competitive signal, that you’re framing into a design implication for the team’s weekly brief. By mid\-morning you’re in a working session with an applied scientist, pressure\-testing the interaction model for an AI\-generated observability insight before it goes into prototyping. You’re not waiting for a PM to write the brief. You’re shaping the problem definition. Afternoons might be a prototype review with a customer, gathering direct signal on whether the attack path visualization reads as actionable or overwhelming. Or it’s a cross\-domain sync, where you’re reconciling interaction patterns between domains so that users moving between products don’t feel the seams. At this level, your output isn’t screens, it’s the design intelligence that sharpens how the entire team operates. You’re setting the bar for craft, bringing structure to ambiguous problem spaces, and making the case for design at the product definition layer, not after it.
  

  

About the team  

The SSOG design team shapes the experience of AWS’s most technically demanding products — Security, Observability, Governance, and Search. We cover a portfolio that includes GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudWatch, OpenSearch, and next\-generation agentic surfaces like Security Workbench and Horizon. Our work spans the AWS Console, standalone web UIs, and increasingly the IDE, where security, observability, and governance signals are converging into the developer workflow itself.  

  

We operate as an AI\-native builder team. Every designer works directly alongside engineering in shared workflows, using tools like Kiro and our own SSOG Brain, a multi\-agent design intelligence system we built to accelerate research synthesis, user flow generation, and UX quality review across domains. We don’t hand off specs and wait. We prototype, run experiments, and push toward production.  

  

The problems we’re solving are genuinely hard: how do you make agentic security investigations legible to a CISO? How do you design trust and explainability into systems that act autonomously? How do you unify five distinct products into a cohesive operational experience without flattening what makes each one useful? If that’s the kind of challenge that pulls you in, you’ll find your people here.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------


1\. 12\+ years of professional experience in UX/Product Design, with at least 4 years at Staff/Principal level (or equivalent) at a top\-tier technology company  

2\. Demonstrable portfolio of shipped enterprise\-scale B2B products, with emphasis on data\-intensive or security\-domain interfaces  

3\. Deep expertise in design systems — architecture, governance, component libraries, and cross\-team adoption at scale  

4\. Strong technical fluency: ability to read, review, and contribute to production code (HTML/CSS/JS, React preferred)  

5\. Experience designing for complex data visualization — dashboards, threat detection, network topology, log analysis  

6\. Track record of influencing product strategy at the organizational level, not just feature\-level execution

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------


1\. Direct experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or observability platforms
  

2\. Hands\-on experience with AI/ML product design, particularly agentic patterns
  

3\. Experience building from 01 and establishing product\-market fit for new product lines  

4\. Published thought leadership or recognized contributions to the design community  

5\. Proficiency with AI\-assisted design and development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, v0\)

results.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon’s Applied AI Solutions org is seeking a talented and passionate Senior UX Designer to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences team. This user experience role will have a significant impact on our business as you contribute to the strategy and design direction for AI\-native product experiences that serve scientists, clinicians, and healthcare professionals. Throughout the strategy, design, and development lifecycle, you will work collaboratively with your design team, alongside engineers, product managers, and scientists, building future\-forward experiences that leverage agentic AI capabilities to accelerate drug discovery, improve patient outcomes, and transform healthcare delivery.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will lead design initiatives with a particular focus on designing, constraining, and validating AI agent behavior as a core UX artifact for healthcare and life sciences applications. You will lead initiatives working collaboratively with a cross\-functional team of product managers, UX researchers, scientists, and engineers to explore, innovate, and create ways in which we can help our customers accelerate scientific discovery and improve patient care.  

  

Your role is to identify opportunities across experiences and resolve gaps in our product strategy, building inter\-operational product experiences that solve for those opportunities while ensuring AI\-assisted experiences remain transparent, trustworthy, and grounded in real human needs. You understand that healthcare and life sciences users maintain exceptionally high trust bars—they require AI systems that cite sources, explain reasoning, and support rather than replace professional judgment. You approach AI not as a feature or shortcut, but as a system that must be intentionally designed, tested, and governed within the context of scientific rigor and regulatory compliance.
  

  

You have an “anything is possible” mindset when faced with seemingly hard problems and thrive on uncovering deep customer insights. You love being part of a highly collaborative and high\-energy team that isn’t afraid to swing for the fences. You’re proud of your work, your skills and expertise – but flexible and open to cross\-functional team input, as you want to be part of something impactful.
  

  

A day in the life  

* Craft and validate long\-term design strategies through customer research, prototyping, and proposal documents that advocate for the needs of scientists, clinicians, and healthcare professionals
* Define AI agent personas and behavioral contracts that articulate the agent's role, responsibilities, boundaries, and escalation behavior—with particular attention to scientific accuracy, citation requirements, and appropriate confidence levels
* Design for multiple personas with varying technical expertise—from bench scientists with deep biological knowledge to computational biologists managing complex pipelines to clinicians requiring actionable insights
* Design for both happy path experiences and edge cases, including error states and high\-risk situations where AI behavior could mislead users or compromise scientific integrity
* Ensure AI agents are designed to assist users by providing guidance, literature\-based reasoning, and synthesis—rather than taking ownership of scientific or clinical decisions
* Leverage existing design systems (Trans Am, with future transition to RAD) while innovating with domain\-specific patterns, scientific visualizations, and terminology that resonates with scientific users
* Accelerate design delivery through vibe coding and AI\-assisted prototyping tools, creating functional prototypes that demonstrate complex scientific workflows
* Conduct ethnographic studies and user research with scientists and clinicians to understand workflows, collaboration patterns, and trust requirements
* Partner with engineering and science teams to translate prototypes into production\-ready specifications, maintaining alignment through regular syncs and feature tracking documentation

  

About the team  

At AAIS, we are building solutions tailored for organizations operating at the intersection of technology and human health. Our products serve computational biologists, bench scientists, clinicians, and healthcare administrators—users who require exceptional precision, trust, and transparency in their tools. We are creating AI\-assisted experiences that democratize complex scientific workflows, enabling researchers to accelerate the design\-build\-test\-learn (DBTL) cycle in drug discovery while maintaining the rigorous standards required in regulated environments.  

  

Our ambition is to transform the way life\-saving drugs are made and healthcare is delivered by combining real\-time scientific intelligence with the latest computational models and tools. We create AI\-assisted experiences so intuitive that scientists and clinicians can focus on their expertise—the technology simply supports their work without getting in the way.  

  

At AWS Solutions, we are building "scaled applications"—solutions tailored for businesses operating at global scale, addressing challenges that few others can. At the heart of this direction is the integration of agentic AI into our product experiences. Unlike generic SaaS products, these solutions leverage Amazon's unique experience and expertise, used by millions of companies around the world to manage their day\-to\-day operations. Our ambition is to create AI\-assisted experiences so intuitive that customers don't even know they're using AI—the magic just happens.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of design experience
* Have an available online portfolio
* Experience with design tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign and prototyping in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Ajax

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience applying scrum to visual or UX design processes
* Experience with UX design of complex workflows
